metadata.title: Tipra Motha -Amit Shah Meet | Tripura News | Adivasi Daily
metadata.description: Central Home Minister Amit Shah meet Tipra Motha met Pradyut Manikya Deb barma in Agartala on Wednesday, March 8. He has promised to appoint a interlocutor to look in to the demand of a greater tipraland state. Will it be bigining of relationship between Tipra and BJP?
